newsitem.title: CANADA: NOVA Alberta pipeline restart delayed.
newsitem.headline: NOVA Alberta pipeline restart delayed.

text.p: NOVA Corp said on Thursday that a scheduled maintenance outage that has removed about one billion cubic feet of natural gas a day from its intra-Alberta pipeline system was extended until late Friday.
The maintenance run on NOVA Gas Transmission Ltd's Grande Prairie mainline in northern Alberta was previously slated to end today.
However, the company experienced mechanical problems with its in-line inspection tool, delaying the restart, NGTL team leader of operations planning Dave Schultz said.
"So, the gas restriction will be in place until tomorrow evening," Schultz said.
The outage began on Sunday. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
